title: Pocketwire Rewards Quarterly Milestone Bonus Amount
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards milestone tier amount is the milestone bonus points of the tier held on the credit date, and the quarterly milestone bonus is that milestone tier amount, in whole points.

## Calculation

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Tier held on the credit date | the membership record on the day the bonus is booked |
| Milestone bonus points of that tier | the product's tier figure, the milestone bonus points |

The points credited are the milestone tier amount as a whole number of points.

## Worked examples (hypothetical memberships)

- The tier held on the credit date has milestone bonus points of 3000. The quarterly milestone bonus credited is 3000 points.
- A membership reached the milestone for a quarter and moved up a tier at the review on the first day of the next quarter, before the bonus was credited. The tier held on the credit date, the higher tier, sets the milestone tier amount.

## Basis question

Which tier's figure is used for the amount? The tier held on the credit date.
